title: The level curve xy = 25 just touches x + y = 10
caption: On the constraint line x + y = 10 the product xy is largest where the level curve xy = 25 only touches the line, at (5, 5). There the curve and the line have the same gradient −1, which is what ∇f = λ∇g says.
alt: The hyperbola xy = 25 touching the line x + y = 10 at the single point (5, 5).
description: The constraint is the line y = 10 − x; the level curves of xy are hyperbolas.
The level xy = 25 touches the line at (5, 5) without crossing it.
Both have gradient −1 there, so the gradients of f and g are parallel.
Hence the maximum of xy on the line is 25.

checks.name: on the line, xy = x(10 − x) is largest at x = 5 with value 25
